title: Identity and integration ops
summary: The hands-on work of connecting a product to a customer: SSO with OIDC and SAML against Okta, Entra ID or Keycloak, provisioning, machine-to-machine API auth, file feeds over SFTP, and testing and debugging all of it with Postman, Newman, curl and a SAML tracer.
intro: Every enterprise deal ends with the same three tickets: single sign-on against the customer's identity provider, a machine credential for the integration, and a nightly file or a webhook. This module teaches that work the way an implementation or solutions engineer does it: the browser mechanics and tokens underneath every login, OAuth 2.x and OpenID Connect the current way, SAML 2.0 and the Okta and Entra ID consoles, SCIM provisioning, API keys and signed webhooks, SFTP feeds, and the collections, tracers and logs that prove an integration works and show why it does not. Every practice path runs against a local Keycloak or SFTP server in Docker, with a no-Docker route named.

lessons.title: Web sessions: cookies, CORS, CSRF and TLS
OpenID Connect: ID tokens, discovery and logout
Setting up SSO and provisioning with Okta and Entra ID
Machine-to-machine API auth: keys, client credentials, mTLS and signed webhooks
API testing with Postman, Newman, Bruno and curl
The SSO and integration troubleshooting runbook
